polityNote: Republic of Seychelles from the 1998 redistricting (Les Mamelles and Roche Caïman created, Anse Louis renamed Au Cap) to 2019. Atoms are geoBoundaries SYC ADM1 (2018, CC BY-SA 3.0), 25 districts plus the Outer Islands. Earlier districts (1979/1991: 23, La Digue and Silhouette merged 1994) are not drawn: Plaisance lost part of its land to the two 1998 districts along a line no atom carries.
